title: A Vision for Operationalising Diversity and Inclusion in AI
benchmark_measurement: Inclusion of religion as a protected attribute in a proposed persona-generation framework for AI requirements engineering.
findings: The paper posits that religion is a critical protected attribute that must be considered and included in the requirements engineering process for AI systems to ensure diversity, equity, and prevent the perpetuation of biases. However, it does not present specific findings on religious bias in any model.
